name: Workshop Platform
description: Adds workshop-builder platform tools: step UI, web terminal, goss validation. Serves the workshop at port 8080.

workshopPath.description: Path to the workshop directory (containing workshop.yaml), relative to the workspace root

step.description: Step ID to start at. All prior steps have their setup (files + commands) pre-applied. Empty = start at step 1.

version.description: Version of workshop platform tools to install (GitHub release tag)
